routes.contract: unique name is the DB arbiter; deterministic target id; actor authority and audit receipt commit with the row; exact replay acknowledges, changed material conflicts
material CAS on current name/permissions/description; unique-name conflict 409; stale target 409; audit readback and replay reconciliation
conditional delete with NOT EXISTS assigned users and material predicates; in-use/stale conflict; tombstone receipt
unique email DB arbiter; role-existence EXISTS in the insert; actor authority and audit receipt commit atomically; no password hash in receipt
material CAS including last_login; role-existence EXISTS on role change; stale/concurrent login change 409; audit readback
material conditional delete; stale target 409; tombstone receipt and exact replay acknowledgement
exact TenantSetting('billing').setting_value CAS; partial merge of supplied fields; finite/non-negative/mode validation; concurrent loser 409; fresh-session budget consumers observe committed truth

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id; supplied ids are prefixed deterministically
durable_ledger.material_binding: operation kind, actor id/role, platform/tenant scope, target type/id, request material digest and result digest
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session on the same engine; target state must still match the result digest or be absent for delete
durable_ledger.replay: same id/same material already_applied; changed material 409; later target revision/audit mismatch 503; lost confirmation effect_unknown 503
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no password hash, token, secret, OTP or SQL parameter stored or returned

response_contract.verified: existing success shape plus additive verification/operation_id/audit_id
response_contract.conflict: 409 typed conflict; refresh the changed record
response_contract.uncertain: 503 with original operation/audit/target identities and do_not_repeat
response_contract.refused: existing 403/404/422 refusal shape with zero mutation
